results.title: Syntia: Synthesizing the Semantics of Obfuscated Code | USENIX
results.snippet: # Syntia: Synthesizing the Semantics of Obfuscated Code. Current state-of-the-art deobfuscation approaches operate on instruction traces and use a mixed approach of symbolic execution and taint analysis; two techniques that require precise analysis of the underlying code. As program synthesis can synthesize code of arbitrary code complexity, it is only limited by the complexity of the underlying code’s *semantic*. To demonstrate the practical feasibility of our approach, we automatically learn the semantics of 489 out of 500 random expressions obfuscated via Mixed Boolean-Arithmetic. Finally, to substantiate our claim that the approach is generic and applicable to different use cases, we show that Syntia can also automatically learn the semantics of ROP gadgets.
